target_customer: Small and mid-size factories (initially automotive and electronics suppliers in Indonesia, Vietnam and India) that still run on Excel
problem: Four million factories run on spreadsheets and siloed unstructured data; enterprise ERPs like SAP can cost over $1M.
business_model: B2B SaaS ERP with AI agents (pricing not found)

founders.name: Edward Zhang
prior_employers: Apple (led scaling of Services API gateway)

competitors.name: SAP
competitors.what: Enterprise ERP cited as costing over $1M

technical_complexity.rationale: Workflow engine, CRM, item library and quotation module on LLM extraction of unstructured data; standard B2B engineering with hard integration parts.

defensibility.rationale: ERPs lock in once running a factory, but early traction is a handful of factories and no network effect yet.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found; the YC launch post names only SAP, and Odoo is named from general knowledge.

market_need_then: YC launch post says four million factories rely on Excel and claims work with several factories in Indonesia, Vietnam and India; company claims, not verified.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain, founder-voice launch posts ('Rippling for factories')

brand_strength.rationale: Short friendly word, but 'Tiny' is generic and shared by other 'Tiny ERP' products (e.g. a Brazilian ERP); the domain prefix 'and' suggests tiny.com was unavailable. No brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Tiny is a Fall 2024 YC company building an AI ERP for factories in Southeast Asia and India, started by two ex-Zenefits and Addepar colleagues with an Apple infrastructure engineer. It is active with three people and a few factory pilots. Aggregators report only about $500K raised and no outside press or priced traction was found, so it is early and unproven.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators report a $500K pre-seed or seed with conflicting dates (June 2024 vs December 2024) and one CB Insights snippet mentions a Series A that probably belongs to another Tiny; none recorded as a round. Many 'Tiny ERP' results refer to a Brazilian company and Tiiny AI is also unrelated. The andtiny.com fetch returned no usable content. The YC launch post was dated using the directory launch time (about Nov 2024).
